Lionel Messi scores AGAIN! 🐐⚽️
Messi found the back of the net for Inter Miami against Toronto FC with a brilliant finish in the 82nd minute. Rodrigo De Paul provided the assist, but Miami couldn't complete the comeback and lost 1-2.
What a moment from Messi! 🔥

snippet.title: Ronaldo’s Last Dance… 💔🇵🇹#ronaldo #football
snippet.description:
A legend. A final dream. One last dance.

Cristiano Ronaldo’s World Cup journey came down to one final chance. Portugal faced Spain in a battle that could decide the end of an era.

No matter the result, Ronaldo’s legacy will never be forgotten.

The last chapter of one of football’s greatest stories. 🇵🇹🐐
